create_search_agent: create a SearchAgent instance with opt config to retrieve documents from a search server
use_search_agent_act: use SearchAgent.act to retrieve top N documents for the current observation text
use_search_agent_respond: use SearchAgent.respond to query a search server and get retrieved document text
configure_search_agent_args: configure SearchAgent command-line args for server choice, n-docs, and intra-doc delimiter
use_search_agent_reset: use SearchAgent.reset to clear the top_docs list and reset agent state
